best_idea: Check every slot of a multi-slot blessing set before charging anything, charge once, then renew on a server timer that switches the set off when the balance is short.
decision_why: Keep the check-all-then-charge-once activation and the renew-or-switch-off timer for favour; fix the donor level bypass so a too-low tier refuses the whole activation; blessings become timed rows on the CC ladder, not item stat blocks.
acceptance: A server test: a level-10 player asks for a tier that needs level 20; the request is refused, the favour balance is unchanged and no blessing row exists. At 600000 ms on the server clock the blessing renews once and debits the tier cost; with too little favour the row ends.
